environment.description: Terraform provider deployed in CI/CD pipeline on self-hosted runner. Provider config initializes FeatureFlags from environment variable TF_PROVIDER_LEGACY_VALIDATION=true, which maps to use-legacy-key-validation=true. No network jitter normalization. Provider binary runs with direct network access to the key validation endpoint over low-latency localhost loopback.

config.network: provider and key endpoint co-located on same host (loopback), <0.1ms RTT variance
config.launchdarkly_sdk: not configured, falls back to env var mapping
